requirements: Make assessmentStaysCurrent(changedPaths) in src/assessment.js decide whether a code assessment stays current after an edit: it does when every changed path is documentation, meaning a Markdown file or any file under docs/. Instruction files are code even though they are Markdown, because agents follow them: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md in any directory, and every file under skills/ or .claude/, so an edit to one makes the code assessment stale. Paths are repository-relative with forward slashes and exact case, as Git lists them.

defects.consequence: isDocumentation exempts only AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, so an edit to a Markdown file under skills/ or .claude/ keeps the code assessment current and the changed instructions pass without code review.
defects.origin: A documentation-only edit makes the code assessment stale

decoys.consequence: A non-Markdown file under docs/ is treated as code, so an edit to a diagram makes the code assessment stale.
decoys.evidence: src/assessment.js:7 isDocumentation accepts only Markdown files
decoys.reason: isDocumentation also accepts every path starting with docs/, whatever its extension.
